title: God Knows What Is Best
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
"We want a king!" the people said
To Samuel, old and gray.
"The other nations all have one!"
So Samuel knelt to pray.

[Chorus]
Be thankful for the things you have,
And trust the Lord's good plan.
He knows what's best for you, my child,
Much better than we can.

[Verse 2]
God said, "They do not want My way,
They push aside their King."
Then Samuel warned, "A king will take
Your fields and everything."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So count your blessings one by one,
As sleepy eyelids fall.
Heavenly Father gave you these,
He loves you most of all.

[Chorus]
mood: Rocking music. A light, gentle sway in two moves under the voice, simple and homey, like a grandmother rocking on a porch and counting the good things already at hand. The first verses stay unhurried and a little wistful, never scolding, letting the story breathe. By the last verse the sway slows and drops lower, each blessing counted more softly than the one before, until the rocking nearly stops.
